thread:
dev-rel-anna: Quick heads-up for next week's release train — we're adjusting cadence and adding a short partial freeze window. Please read and react if you have dependencies. :eyes:

sam: tl;dr?

dev-rel-anna: TL;DR — cadence -> Tue/Thu deploy lanes (canary on Tue, ramp Thu). Partial freeze Wed 00:00-06:00 UTC for hotpatch-only ops. No schema or model migrations during freeze unless approved by release leads. Full details & runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-train-2026>.

cheng: noted. moving our model rollout to Thu canary then. pls confirm KV-cache warmup won't be affected. :+1:

sam: KV warmup handled by the rollout job, should be fine. I'll add an extra 30m warmup step in the canary job.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MT-4532 — "Release train cadence shift & partial freeze" (owner: sam). Scheduled Wed 00:00-06:00 UTC.

eloise: QA note — we'll shift smoke + regression handoffs to Tue 08:30 UTC to align with canary. If anyone needs different timing ping me.

maya: FYI: does the migration for shard-routing (schema-shard routing) need to be delayed? I have a migration script planned Wed night.

sam: Yes please postpone the shard-routing migration to Thu 02:00 UTC (post-canary ramp) unless you get explicit sign-off. The freeze window is Wed 00:00-06:00 UTC so Wed night is risky.

maya: ack, will reschedule.

product-lead-raj: Are there customer-facing risk windows? Anything to call out in support slack?

dev-rel-anna: No planned customer downtime. We may see short degradation risk if a hotpatch is required during the freeze window; support should expect a delayed patching timeline. I'll draft a short FYI for #support in the morning.

cheng: small ask — can we get a quick snippet for the canary job so ops knows the extra warmup?

sam: sure, here's the diff I'll include in the job config:

```yaml
- steps:
-   - name: canary-deploy
-     action: deploy
+ steps:
+   - name: prewarm-kv-cache
+     action: run
+     cmd: scripts/prewarm_kv.sh --timeout 1800
+   - name: canary-deploy
+     action: deploy
```

sam: I'll also update the runbook and the PR for the canary job.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Weekly deploy rhythm change will auto-enforce branch protection for Tue/Thu merges starting next week.

eloise: noted, updating QA checklist.

dev-rel-anna: Thanks all. If you have any cross-team blockers, drop them here or DM me. Will post the short support FYI in #support at 09:00 UTC. :rocket:
